label: R17-FP-P1-SPLIT
title: Split the ordinary FP round-pack p1 normalization cone
model_selection: spawn_agent/followup_task omits model; user-confirmed default gpt-5.6-luna[max]
dependency_override: Speculative timing implementation starts from the exact T-009 candidate while its broad functional validation is still running; this lane may not integrate until T-009 is done.
scope: Use the Round16 top-50 raw report to split round_pack_p1's normalization/leading-bit/GRS construction into one additional real register boundary for ordinary pp_pre producers. Preserve the existing iterative DIV/SQRT path, special-value priority, FPCR rounding/FZ/DN/AHP behavior, packed-half dual-lane semantics, response hold, kill/reset, and architectural commit timing.
forbidden_regions: false paths, assertion disable, or reference-result changes
pre_batch_validation: static RTL/state/reset/kill/hold review only while the T-009 heavy queue is occupied
batch_acceptance_tests: FP exec directed SV and Cocotb
P7-1/P7-3/P7-4/P7-5 SV+Cocotb and strict lockstep matrices
reset/kill/valid-drop/backpressure checks for the added state
acceptance: The new boundary materially shortens pp_pre-to-pack register combinational depth, adds no combinational bypass, and clears all new non-architectural state on reset/kill/valid-drop. The owner stops after implementation, directed test updates, and static review; integration and all simulation/physical claims are made only by the batch integrator.

review.summary: Exact-SHA functional union passed; T-014 proves old pp_pre-to-pack_mid is a true 0-path. New pp_pre-to-pack_pre cone is carried into T-017.

review_result.notes: Independent review accepted the p0/p1 split after e4f3d5b restored the missing round_pack_h emax declaration. This remains speculative until merged onto the repaired T-009 base and jointly validated, then physically measured.

board_policy: No assembler, bitstream generation, JTAG, programming, power-on, or board test without explicit user permission.
